blueprint.name: Private Harbor registry on an IBM Cloud VSI
blueprint.description: A private Harbor OCI registry on an IBM Cloud VSI, attached to a Transit Gateway so air-gapped cluster nodes reach it privately. Its TLS certificate is issued by terraform, so the CA is a module output rather than something to fetch off the box. Optionally replicates the BNK supply chain from FAR on the way up — the mirror takes the registry address and CA straight from the harbor module, so one deployment leaves a registry a disconnected install can use immediately.

outcomes: A services VPC attached to your existing Transit Gateway
Harbor running on a VSI, TLS covering both its private and floating IPs
registry_host + vpc_id outputs ready for the mirror, FLP and BNK blueprints

prerequisites.description: An IBM Cloud credential template on the project. The opentofu engine injects its API key into the IBM provider; no key is ever a module input.
An existing IBM Cloud VPC SSH key, attached so an operator can reach the VSI to inspect Harbor or read its CA.
An existing Transit Gateway. The services VPC is attached to it so the air-gapped cluster can pull images over the private path.

input_summary.label: Why the private IP matters
input_summary.value: Harbor derives its Bearer token-service realm from its hostname, which cloud-init sets to the VSI's PRIVATE IP. A floating-IP hostname would leave that realm unreachable from no-egress worker nodes and every pull would ImagePullBackOff. The TLS SAN covers both addresses, so the operator can still use the floating IP.

input_summary.label: Egress
input_summary.value: The services subnet gets a public gateway: Harbor is the one component that must reach F5's registry to mirror from. The cluster side keeps none.

input_summary.label: Next step
input_summary.value: Feed registry_host into the mirror blueprint (as the private registry host) and vpc_id into the FLP-VSI blueprint.

required.name: prefix
required.label: Resource prefix
required.description: Prefix for every resource this blueprint names (e.g. acme-svc).

required.name: region
required.label: IBM Cloud region
required.description: Region for the services VPC and the Harbor VSI. Inherits from the selected credential template.

required.name: ssh_key_name
required.label: SSH key name
required.description: Name of an existing IBM Cloud VPC SSH key to attach to the VSI.

required.name: harbor_admin_password
required.label: Harbor admin password
required.description: Password for Harbor's admin user — the same credential the mirror blueprint pushes with and the BNK install pulls with.

required.name: transit_gateway
required.label: Existing Transit Gateway (name or ID)
required.description: The gateway the services VPC is attached to, so the air-gapped cluster reaches Harbor privately.

optional.name: resource_group
optional.label: Resource group
optional.description: IBM Cloud resource group. Inherits from the selected credential template.

optional.name: zone
optional.label: Zone
optional.description: Zone for the subnet and VSI. Blank = the region's first zone.

optional.name: subnet_cidr
optional.label: Services subnet CIDR
optional.description: CIDR for the services subnet. MUST NOT overlap the cluster VPC: roksbnkctl fixes its cluster subnets at 10.241.0.0/24, 10.241.64.0/24 and 10.241.128.0/24, so anything in 10.241.0.0/16 risks colliding once both VPCs are on the same Transit Gateway — the cluster would route the mirror's address to its own subnet.

optional.name: harbor_version
optional.label: Harbor version
optional.description: Harbor release tag to install (the offline installer).

optional.name: vsi_profile
optional.label: VSI profile
optional.description: IBM Cloud instance profile for the Harbor VSI.

optional.name: boot_size_gb
optional.label: Boot volume (GB)
optional.description: Boot volume size. A full BNK mirror plus Harbor's offline installer needs room.

optional.name: vsi_image
optional.label: VSI image
optional.description: Stock image for the Harbor VSI.

optional.name: management_allowed_cidrs
optional.label: Management allowed CIDRs
optional.description: Comma-separated CIDRs allowed to reach :443 and :22 on the floating IP. Blank = 0.0.0.0/0.

optional.name: registry_allowed_cidrs
optional.label: Registry allowed CIDRs
optional.description: Comma-separated CIDRs allowed to reach :443 privately over the Transit Gateway. Blank = the RFC-1918 ranges.

optional.name: create_vpc
optional.label: Create the services VPC
optional.description: On = create the VPC, subnet and public gateway. Off = adopt the existing VPC and subnet named below.

optional.name: existing_vpc_id
optional.label: Existing VPC ID
optional.description: Services VPC to adopt when 'Create the services VPC' is off.

optional.name: existing_subnet_id
optional.label: Existing subnet ID
optional.description: Subnet to adopt when 'Create the services VPC' is off.

optional.name: public_gateway
optional.label: Attach a public gateway
optional.description: Harbor needs egress to mirror from F5's registry. Turn this off only if the subnet already has an egress path.

optional.name: services_spare_cidr
optional.label: Spare services prefix
optional.description: A second address prefix in the services VPC, reserved for appliances that allocate their own subnet from the VPC pool — roksbnkctl's FLP VSI does. A prefix that exactly equals the subnet leaves nothing to allocate. Must not overlap the subnet or the cluster VPC. Blank disables it.

optional.name: registry_projects
optional.label: Registry projects
optional.description: Comma-separated Harbor projects to create once the registry is up. Harbor does not auto-create a project on push and `registry replicate` does not either, so a missing project surfaces as 401 Unauthorized on the manifest HEAD — which reads like a credential fault. Defaults cover the mirror target and the flp-status image project.

optional.name: registry_repo_prefix
optional.label: Registry repository prefix
optional.description: Project / repository prefix inside the mirror (a Harbor project, an Artifactory repo key). Used only when the FAR mirror module is enabled.

optional.name: cos_instance
optional.label: Supply-chain COS instance
optional.description: COS instance holding the FAR auth key + subscription JWT. Blank = bnk-supply-chain. Used only when the FAR mirror module is enabled.

optional.name: cos_bucket
optional.label: Supply-chain COS bucket
optional.description: Orchestration COS bucket holding the FAR auth tarball and the subscription JWT. The runner has no local copies, so it resolves them from here; buckets provisioned by `roksbnkctl init` carry a per-account suffix (bnk-artifacts-<account>). Used only when the FAR mirror module is enabled.

optional.name: cos_region
optional.label: Supply-chain COS region
optional.description: Region of that bucket. Blank = us-south. Used only when the FAR mirror module is enabled.

optional.name: far_auth_file
optional.label: FAR auth object name
optional.description: Object name of the FAR auth tarball in the bucket. Blank = f5-far-auth-key.tgz. Used only when the FAR mirror module is enabled.

optional.name: subscription_jwt_file
optional.label: Subscription JWT object name
optional.description: Object name of the subscription JWT in the bucket. Blank = subscription.jwt. Used only when the FAR mirror module is enabled.

optional.name: manifest_version
optional.label: BNK manifest version
optional.description: BNK manifest release to install. Blank = the roksbnkctl default. Used only when the FAR mirror module is enabled.

modules.name: Harbor registry (VSI)
modules.description: Services VPC + Transit Gateway attachment + Harbor on a VSI, installed by cloud-init.

modules.name: Replicate from FAR
modules.description: Optional, and created DISABLED — enable it to fill the registry as it is built. The registry address and its CA come from the harbor module's outputs, so there is nothing to copy by hand. Needs BNK Forge with the container dependency-output wiring (PR #519); without it the inputs resolve to nothing and the step fails reporting a missing registry host. Leave it off to build an empty registry and mirror later with the FAR mirror blueprint.
